Standard: Following sudden asymmetric loss of thrust from any factor while on the ground, the air vehicle is controllable with no worse than Level 2 flying qualities, including in crosswinds up to takeoff and landing maximum limits from the unfavorable direction, as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Lateral-Directional Control with Asymmetric Thrust paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's lateral-directional control for takeoff and landing with asymmetric thrust as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Lateral-Directional Control with Asymmetric Thrust paragraph, Thrust Loss during Takeoff Run paragraph, Thrust Loss after Takeoff paragraph, Thrust Loss during Waveoff/Go-Around paragraph, and Two- Engine Failures in Multi-Engine Air Vehicles paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, runway conditions, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's lateral-directional control for takeoff and landing with asymmetric thrust as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Lateral-Directional Control with Asymmetric Thrust paragraph, Thrust Loss during Takeoff Run paragraph, Thrust Loss after Takeoff paragraph, Thrust Loss during Waveoff/Go- Around paragraph, and Two-Engine Failures in Multi-Engine Air Vehicles paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, runway conditions, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's lateral-directional control for takeoff and landing with asymmetric thrust as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Lateral-Directional Control with Asymmetric Thrust paragraph, Thrust Loss during Takeoff Run paragraph, Thrust Loss after Takeoff paragraph, Thrust Loss during Waveoff/Go-Around paragraph, and Two-Engine Failures in Multi-Engine Air Vehicles paragraph, for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, runway conditions, and environmental conditions.
